title: 专家：美国已实际失去麻疹消除状态，控制能力不再
speaker: Dr. Amish Adolgez

segments.en: No, I think that the United States has effectively lost its elimination status.
segments.zh: 不，我认为美国实际上已经失去了消除状态。

segments.en: And even if by some technicality, it maintains its elimination status, the deeper question is does the United States have resiliency against measles? The answer is no.
segments.zh: 即使因技术原因保留消除状态，更深层的问题是：美国是否具备抵御麻疹的能力？答案是否定的。

segments.en: Irrespective of what the elimination status decision is, and there will be politics around the elimination decision.
segments.zh: 无论消除状态的决定如何，其中都涉及政治因素。

segments.en: So I think it's just for all intents and purposes, the U.S. does not have the ability to control measles any longer.
segments.zh: 因此，实际上美国已不再具备控制麻疹的能力。
